title: Suspicious Behavior
paragraphs: “Understood.”
“What is?”
“If I chase after him right now and kill him, that should be enough, correct? He deserves death in more ways than one.”
As I declared this after finishing Sakura-chan’s treatment, Father placed a hand on his forehead in exasperation. An unforgivable act of barbarism. Simply killing him wouldn’t be enough.
“Sigh… I understand how you feel, but Motoyasu-kun, do you have a plan?”
“A plan is secondary to exacting retribution for Sakura-chan’s injury. He must pay with his life!”
“You’re the one who said that if we do something like that, it wouldn’t just cause a commotion—it would start a war!”
“Ugh… it hurt so much…”
“I’m sorry! It’s all my fault because I couldn’t hold back!”
Fiancée apologized to both Sakura-chan and Father.
“Don’t worry about it. Thank you for getting along with Sakura-chan and the others.”
Father spoke to Fiancée with a smile. Because of what had happened earlier, she blushed slightly.
Again? Is she aiming for Father again?
Even though she already has Filo-tan! As I stomped my foot in frustration, Fiancée looked at Father… then suddenly snapped back to her senses and took a few steps back.
“The Four Saints…”
“What’s wrong, Mel-chan?”
When Sakura-chan asked, Fiancée shook her head vigorously.
“N-no, it’s nothing. More importantly, Sakura-chan, are you okay?”
“Yeah, it doesn’t hurt anymore!”
“But there’s still a scar…”
“If it’s just this much, I can heal it with a combination of medicine and magic.”
“I see… in that case, it should be fine…”
Father crouched down to match Fiancée’s height and looked her in the eye.
What is he planning?
“Alright then, I’ll escort you home. Where are your family members?”
Fiancée shook her head several times and waved her hands. She seemed quite flustered.
“I-I’m fine! It’s really close by!”
“But wouldn’t it be dangerous if you got attacked again like earlier?”
At Father’s words, Fiancée lowered her hands in resignation.
“Umm, in that case… if you could just take me to the castle, that would be enough. My mother is there.”
“Got it. Then, while we walk, why don’t you chat with Sakura-chan and the others?”
“Yeah! Mel-chan, let’s talk!”
“Iwatani, what about continuing hide-and-seek?”
“We’ll do that next time when we play with Mel-chan again, okay, Kou?”
At Father’s request, Kou flinched for a moment but soon realized there was nothing to be afraid of and nodded. That’s right. If Father is angry, it’s only at Takt.
“Okay!”
“What a shame. I was planning to surprise Mel when she got flustered from not being able to find me.”
“Haha, everyone is so full of energy. Alright, let’s go. Let’s escort Mel-chan.”
“Yes!”

Yuki-chan and the others nodded energetically, and then Sakura-chan began walking with Fiancée riding on her back. Their closeness was enough to make me jealous. It’s frustrating, but I suppose this confirms that Fiancée is my rival.
“Honestly… don’t go causing trouble, na no!”
“Exactly.”
“But I think Gaelion-chan and the others who just stood by and watched are guilty too…”

“Please wait a moment! Yuki-chan and the others asked for my permission before going out! The only reason things turned out like this is because I forgot about it! So, the one at fault here is entirely me!”
It doesn’t sit well with me to defend my rival, but Yuki-chan and the others are innocent.
Yes… everything that happened is my fault.
“I get it. It was a big deal that Sakura-chan got hurt, but honestly, I’m just relieved that it didn’t turn into something irreversible.”
The path from the courtyard to the castle takes a bit of time. During those ten minutes, Father walked beside me and whispered in my ear.
“Motoyasu-kun, you said that in the previous loop, I claimed there was no way to have a proper conversation with Takt. Now I see why. That guy isn’t the type to listen to people at all.”
Incredible! Father has such a sharp eye for people.
This is a major discovery, indeed!
“I’ve talked to all sorts of people in real life, and I guess you could call it intuition? He’s the kind of person who only does what he wants. And he’s not above using people to get his way.”

Come to think of it, Father was well-connected even in online games. He’s good at negotiations, and unlike me, he probably had plenty of real-life friends too. I recall him mentioning that he used to organize in-game events as well. It’s precisely because of that experience that he has such a keen eye for people.

“And on top of that, did you notice the way he ‘apologized’ just now? It wasn’t even a proper apology. In the end, he acted like we were the ones at fault, didn’t he? Yet, Sakura-chan is the only one who got injured. And more importantly—where are we right now?”

Indeed, this is the royal residence. Starting a violent incident in a place like this could easily lead to severe punishment. And yet, he behaved as if he had done nothing wrong. He probably thinks he’s above everyone else. As I was considering this, Father turned toward Fiancée.
“In a place like this, do they even allow private duels? Are there any regulations or warnings, like something about dragon territory?”
Fiancée shook her head at Father’s words. If such a rule existed, that would be awful.
Would it be something like ‘No First-Time Visitors Allowed’ or something?
“No… I don’t believe there was any such law…”

“In other words, it was just two unsupervised pets getting into a fight on their own. If that were the case, it should be ruled as a mutual fault, yet he twisted the situation to make it seem like we were in the wrong. If you listen carefully, you can already predict his next move.”
It seems that Father is trying to hide it from us and Yuki-chan and the others, but he looks rather displeased. He’s completely switched on.
Oh… A chill runs down my spine, but at the same time, he looks incredibly reliable.
“Private duels are also prohibited, but if I protest, given my lower status, I’ll just end up being cornered instead…”
“I see. If they try anything, I’ll take care of it on my end.”
“…Y-Yes. Thank you very much.”
Oh? Fiancée seems somewhat uneasy. She looks restless. Even though Father just helped her, her reaction is strangely subdued.
“At any rate… When I first heard Motoyasu-kun’s story, I thought he might have gone a bit too far, but now… I think I’ll be joining in on this matter as well.”
Even though he wasn’t actually smiling, to me, it looked like Father was grinning confidently. Once we arrived at the castle entrance, Fiancée got off Sakura-chan’s back and waved her hand.
“Thank you very much! Let’s meet again sometime!”
She’s full of energy. She quickly trotted into the castle and soon disappeared from sight. We then returned to the carriage and told Ren and Itsuki about what had happened.
“Ren-san, where are you going?”
Ren stood up silently, attempting to leave. Itsuki quickly stopped him.
“Where am I going? Isn’t it obvious? I’m going to take down those two.”
“Calm down. Motoyasu-san is getting mixed in with this.”
“How can I stay calm?! Sakura got injured!”
Oh… Ren is getting angry for Sakura-chan’s sake. He’s grown a lot. It’s enough to make me emotional.
“Come to think of it, in the previous loop, Ren used to say that level was everything.”
Considering that, he’s matured quite a bit.
Oh? Ren suddenly froze for a moment. Then, in a quiet voice, he spoke.
“…Sorry. I let my emotions get the better of me. But still… This is a serious situation.”
“Yes… We really should have gone with them.”
“Not necessarily. If Motoyasu-kun had been there, things would have gotten even more chaotic. If both you and Ren had been present, it would have escalated even further.”
“But Sakura got hurt, didn’t she?”
“…Yeah, that’s why—”
Father’s smile made Ren and Itsuki suddenly freeze in realization. Perhaps they were remembering how Kō got punished before.
“I considered giving them a little time for discussion… but let’s skip that and make them face the consequences. Depending on their excuses and actions, they might still have a chance to survive.”
“A-Ahh…”
“They pissed off the one person they should never have. If Motoyasu had arrived first, it might have been easier… in the sense that they’d have died in a single strike.”
Itsuki fell silent, while Ren muttered regretfully. As for me, I was completely captivated by Father’s aura.
“Gyahhh!”
Kō, sensing Father’s killing intent, was trembling. But there’s no need to worry. The one he’s angry at is Takt, not Kō.
